scenario_name: Prescription refill, overdue for a check-up
watch_for: Refills are clinical. Did the agent promise a refill it can't authorize? Did it flag that a lapsed check-up may block the refill? Did it give a specific timeframe or hand off to a nurse?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Oh, no, I'm actually trying to get a refill on my lisinopril prescription.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I can help with that. To request a refill, you'll need a demo patient profile. Would you like to create one now? I just need your first and last name.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Your patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4, 2000 for demo purposes. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: I’m running low on my lisinopril, and I need a refill. When can it be ready?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I don't see any medications on your chart that I can refill right now. If you'd like, I can connect you to our patient support team for more help. Would you like to speak with someone?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Could you double-check under my full name?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I've checked your chart under your full name Tom Riley and there are no medications listed for refill. If you'd like, I can connect you to our patient support team to look into this further. Would you like to be connected?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, let's do that, please. When would they be able to get back to me?
